Assets are both resources used for production, as well as the products facilities can produce. Most assets can be sold for capital. A corporation's asset inventory is unique to each region. Facilities that produce assets will add assets directly to the inventory in the region the facility is built in. The prices for assets are unique to each region and will change every hour. Assets can be moved between regions by exporting them. Some assets will have a '+' in their name to designate that they are a special variant of their normal type. These assets are optionally used by facilities to increase their chances of producing their own '+' variant outputs. Assets that are '+' also have a 4x multiplier on their value when selling in retail stores.
